About This Project > Community > Project history

The project began as a weekend experiment by a small group of friends who liked board games. The mascot is a friendly otter, chosen by a public vote held during the first anniversary party. Every autumn the contributors meet in a different city for a social weekend with food, music, and a charity run. Stickers and mugs are sold in the online shop, and all proceeds support a local library. Newcomers are encouraged to introduce themselves in the welcome channel and share a photo of their desk.

Configuration Reference > Connection Pool > Settings

Name Default Description
max_size 10 Maximum number of open connections
min_idle 2 Minimum number of idle connections kept ready
acquire_timeout 30000 Milliseconds to wait for a free connection
idle_timeout 600000 Milliseconds before an idle connection is closed
max_lifetime 1800000 Milliseconds before a connection is retired
leak_threshold 0 Milliseconds before a leak warning is logged
validation_query none Statement used to test a connection
auto_commit true Default commit mode for new connections

Release Notes > Acknowledgements

We thank everyone who made this release possible. Special thanks go to the translators for the Portuguese and Korean editions, to the volunteers who ran the booth at the spring conference, and to the sponsors who paid for the hosting bills. The cover illustration was drawn by a contributor who prefers to remain anonymous. Our next meetup is planned for early spring, and lunch will be provided. If you would like to become a sponsor, please write to the community team and ask about the supporter tiers and the logo placement on our website.

Command Line Reference > Options > Flags of the sync command

Flag Short Default Description
--dry-run -n off Show planned changes without applying them
--workers -w 4 Number of parallel transfer workers
--timeout -t 60 Seconds before a transfer is abandoned
--retries -r 3 Attempts per file before it is reported
--exclude -x none Glob pattern of paths to skip
--verbose -v off Print every file touched
--checksum -c off Compare content hashes instead of timestamps
--log-file -l none Path of the report file
--config none Path of an alternative settings file

Query Tuning > Execution Plans > Commands

```sql
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders (customer_id, created_at);

EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT o.id, o.total
FROM orders o
WHERE o.customer_id = 42
  AND o.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

VACUUM ANALYZE orders;

SELECT relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Contributing > Code of Conduct > Etiquette

Be kind in chat rooms and forums. Greet people by name when you can, avoid sarcasm in written messages, and remember that many members are volunteers who give their free time. Please keep conversations on the proper channel, mark spoilers for the weekly community quiz, and do not post job advertisements outside the dedicated thread. Moderators may archive threads that drift away from the topic. Birthday wishes are welcome in the social channel, and members often share photos of their pets and favorite lunch spots there.
